facts.fact: A WCO Smart Customs Project mission of 12-16 January 2026 found the Mauritius Revenue Authority hosts critical systems such as the Customs Management System on a private cloud, supporting risk management and border control.

note: MauPass is an e-authentication service; it states nothing on customs declarations, a customs system or a border single window.
The capture holds only aggregate survey scores, not the measure-level customs system, single window or exchange.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Revenue Authority's time release study says bills of entry lodged 10 July to 6 August 2023 were validated, channelled and processed in the Customs Management System (CMS).

The study says the TradeLink national single window was fully rolled out, letting it measure the time other government agencies take on permits and clearances, with CMS checking their clearances; sample period July 2023.
